Dubai’s green corridor with Oman goes live: UAE opens new route for faster sea and air cargo shipments
item.description: Dubai and Oman have launched a new green corridor for sea-air cargo. This initiative promises faster and more efficient trade between Asia and the Middle East. Goods will move seamlessly between sea ports and air cargo facilities. This collaboration aims to reduce transit times and streamline customs. It positions the UAE as a key hub for next-generation global trade routes.

item.title: ​No exams? CBSE announces new evaluation rules for Gulf students​ amid Iran vs US-Israel war
item.description: Amidst escalating Iran vs US-Israel war, CBSE has cancelled Class 10 board exams in Gulf countries, impacting over 50,000 students. A new evaluation scheme uses performance in conducted exams and internal assessments, with averages for missed papers. This unprecedented move prioritises safety, offering a second chance for improvement while preserving global result timelines.

item.description: Bahrain's siren system blares, urging residents to seek immediate shelter. This alert signals a serious escalation in the ongoing Iran vs US-Israel war. Preparedness is no longer optional as the region navigates this critical phase.

item.title: Missile hits Qatar gas hub, fire in key LNG facility shocks global energy markets amid Iran vs US-Israel war
item.description: A missile attack on Qatar's vital gas facility, a shared energy lifeline with Iran, has triggered a fire and damage, escalating the ongoing Iran vs US–Israel war. This strike targets critical global energy infrastructure, raising fears of widespread supply disruptions and economic instability. The incident marks a dangerous shift towards economic warfare, impacting global markets.

item.title: YouTuber PewDiePie says he ‘fixed’ YouTube using his own AI model
item.description: YouTuber PewDiePie has developed his own AI model and browser extension to curate his YouTube feed, removing Shorts and advertisements. This custom tool allows him to bypass distractions and directly access his subscription content and comments. His innovation highlights how users can reclaim control over their online experiences and create a more personalized, distraction-free environment.

item.title: YouTube adds direct messaging feature, expands to 30+ countries in Europe
item.description: YouTube is testing a new feature allowing users to send direct messages within the app. This enables sharing videos and communicating with friends without leaving YouTube. The feature is currently available in over 30 European countries. This update transforms YouTube into a social media platform, simplifying video sharing and potentially boosting creator visibility.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Zakat al Mal vs Zakat al Fitr: Key difference many Muslims still get wrong ahead of Eid ul Fitr 2026; charity rules explained
item.description: As Ramadan 2026 concludes, a key question arises: the distinction between Zakat al Mal and Zakat al Fitr. While both are mandatory Islamic charities, Zakat al Mal is an annual wealth-based obligation, whereas Zakat al Fitr is a fixed per-person charity due before Eid al Fitr prayer, ensuring inclusion for all.

item.title: Iran executed Swedish citizen: Sweden FM
item.description: Sweden's foreign minister on Wednesday said that Iran had executed a Swedish citizen, after Iranian authorities announced the first execution of a man convicted of spying since the start of its war against Israel and the United States. This was the first public announcement of such an execution since Israel and the United States launched strikes on Iran on February 28, killing its supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and triggering the war that has spread across the Middle East.

item.title: “You’re girl-mathing it”: Candace Owens draws criticism over women remark as Erika Kirk series pause impacts YouTube podcast numbers
item.description: Candace Owens claimed her podcast is number one globally, but users on X questioned the data. She replied that a 10-day break to prepare for her Erika Kirk series affected average numbers, not total reach. The exchange has drawn attention to how podcast rankings are calculated and put focus on her upcoming series.

item.title: US intel chief says Iran not rebuilding nuclear programme, undercutting Trump’s war rationale
item.description: US intelligence indicates Iran has not rebuilt nuclear enrichment capacity post-strikes, contradicting President Trump's war justification. Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard's testimony revealed no efforts to restore capability, despite Trump's claims of an imminent threat. This finding fuels Democratic pressure regarding the administration's rationale for the ongoing conflict.
